summary: The department will hold an orientation for new graduate students entering in the 2026 Fall Semester (September 2026 admission), covering graduate courses, theses, graduation, the student centre and other academic matters. All new graduate students are encouraged to attend.

translation:
Orientation for New Graduate Students, Fall Semester 2026 (Students Entering in September 2026)

This new student orientation (OT) will provide a general introduction to academic affairs, including graduate courses, theses, graduation and the student centre [학생센터]. All new graduate students are encouraged to attend.

● Date and time: Wednesday, 26 August 2026, from 2:00 p.m.
● Venue: Room 102, Building 301, Seoul National University
● Who should attend: New graduate students for the 2026 Fall Semester (students entering in September 2026)
● Enquiries: Department Administrative Office [학부행정실] (Room 319, Building 301). The contact person's details are given in the original notice.

Attachment (1 file): 2026-2학기_대학원_신입생_OT.png (1 MB). This attachment is an image and its content was not read; it may contain additional information not included in this translation.
